title: How many collision claims a wholesaler's delivery fleet will make in 2027 on a new route schedule that starts every route before dawn all year, with the recoveries other insurers paid and the bodyshop's repair costs
prompt_shape: 02: the 2027 claims and each 2027 quarter's, with a monthly chart; asks on recoveries by collision quarter and repair cost by depot and period

sources.files: every file under target/ except the bank-holiday feed
sources.origin: generated by task137/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional delivered grocery wholesaler in North East England and Cumbria: four depots, about 250 store routes on 7.5-tonne trucks, three years of telematics, collisions drawn per kilometre from clock time and light, the insurer's claims listing, the bodyshop's jobs and invoices, other insurers' recoveries and the 2027 schedule; every company, person, registration and reference is invented and no real dataset is reproduced
